purpose: Deterministic two-question decision tree mapping creator answers (waive all rights, allow commercial, allow adaptations) to the matching Creative Commons 4.0 license (CC0, CC BY, BY-SA, BY-ND, BY-NC, BY-NC-SA, BY-NC-ND). Returns license id, SPDX id, canonical deed URL, required elements, and attribution requirement. Selection only, not legal advice. Zero network, zero PII.
